steps.title: GTEx Genotype Pre-imputation Quality Control
steps.instruction: Perform sample-level and SNP-level quality control on GTEx version 7 genotype data using PLINK.

substeps.instruction: Filter individuals by genotyping call rate (> 98%) using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --missing --out ${missingness}' and awk.
Perform sex concordance check using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --check-sex --out ${sexcheck}'.
Perform identity check using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --indep-pairwise 50 5 0.2 --out ${relatedness}' followed by genome-full analysis.

Filter SNPs by call rate (> 85%), Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium (p > 1 × 10^-6), and Minor Allele Frequency (MAF > 1%) using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --hwe 1e-6 --geno 0.15 --maf 0.01 --make-bed --out ${output}'.
Remove ambiguous strand SNPs (A/T or C/G) using awk and plink --extract.

steps.title: GTEx Genotype Imputation
steps.instruction: Impute genotype data using SHAPEIT2 and IMPUTE2 with the 1000 Genomes Phase 3 reference panel.

substeps.instruction: Phase data using 'shapeit --input-bed chr${chromosome}.bed chr${chromosome}.bim chr${chromosome}.fam --input-ref ${hapFile} ${legendFile} ${sampleFile} --exclude-snp ${excludeFile} --input-map ${mapFile} -O chr${chromosome}.phased --thread 4 --force'.

Impute genotypes using 'impute2 -use_prephased_g -known_haps_g chr${chromosome}.phased.haps -m ${mapFile} -h ${hapFile} -l ${legendFile} -int $chunkStart $chunkEnd -Ne 20000 -o chr${chromosome}-${chunkStart}-${chunkEnd}.imputed'.

steps.title: GTEx After-imputation Quality Control
steps.instruction: Clean and filter the imputed VCF data using PLINK, VCFtools, and BCFtools.

substeps.instruction: Convert imputed data to VCF format using 'plink --gen ${data.imputed} --oxford-single-chr ${chr} --sample ${phased.sample} --recode-vcf --out ${output}'.
Concatenate VCF files using 'bcftools concat ${data_chr*.vcf} -o ${data.vcf.gz} -O z'.
Filter for biallelic and single-character allele codes only.
Remove ambiguous strand SNPs (A/T or C/G).

Apply final filters: SNP call rate = 100%, HWE p > 1 × 10^-6, MAF > 0.01, and IMPUTE info quality score > 0.8 using 'vcftools --gzvcf ${data.vcf.gz} --snps ${imputed_info0.8_snp} --remove-indels --maf 0.01 --hwe 1e-6 --max-missing 1 --recode --out ${output}'.
Define a cis-window of ± 1Mb from the transcription start site (TSS) with a threshold of p < 0.01.
Run 'QTLtools cis --vcf ${genotype_data} --bed ${expression_data} --cov ${covariates_data} --mapping ${thresholds_file} --chunk n1 n2 --out ${output}'.

steps.title: Train Gene Expression Prediction Models
steps.instruction: Train prediction models using a nested cross-validated elastic-net procedure.

substeps.instruction: Split samples into 5 folds.
Perform 5-fold nested cross-validation: use 4 folds to train the elastic net (with 10-fold CV to tune lambda) and the 5th fold to evaluate correlations between predicted and measured expression.
Assess performance using the average Pearson correlation coefficient across the 5 tests.
Train a final elastic-net model using 10-fold cross-validation on all samples to calculate weights.

steps.title: Perform Transcriptome-Wide Association Study (TWAS)
steps.instruction: Execute TWAS using S-PrediXcan to associate SNPs with Alzheimer's Disease (AD).

substeps.instruction: Utilize GWAS summary data for SNP-AD associations and prediction model weights for SNP-expression associations.

Run 'python MetaXcan.py --model_db_path ${db_file} --covariance ${LD_ref} --gwas_folder ${gwas_folder} --gwas_file_pattern ${gwas_file} --snp_column ${SNP_name} --effect_allele_column ${effect_allele} --non_effect_allele_column ${non_effect_allele} --beta_column ${beta_name} --se_column ${se_name} --output_file ${output}'.

steps.title: Perform Gene-level Fine-mapping
steps.instruction: Perform fine-mapping of causal gene sets using FOCUS.

substeps.instruction: Use the trained hippocampal tissue weighting table and the multiple tissue, multiple eQTL reference panel weight database.
Import prediction modules using 'Python focus ${db_file} predixcan --tissue Hippocampus --name GTEx --assay rnaseq --output ${output}'.

steps.title: Network Topology and Functional Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze network topology and functional enrichment of identified genes.

substeps.instruction: Perform network topology-based analysis using Webgestalt with the BIOGRID human PPI database (Build 3.5.167).
Perform statistical over-representation tests using PANTHER (v.14.0) with Gene Ontology (GO) biological process as reference, using Fisher's exact test and BH-FDR correction (q < 0.05).
Detect hippocampal tissue functional modules using HumanBase, testing GO term significance via one-sided Fisher’s exact test and BH-FDR correction (q < 0.05).

steps.title: ADNI Genotype Pre-imputation Quality Control
steps.instruction: Perform quality control on ADNI genotype data using PLINK.

substeps.instruction: Filter individuals by genotyping call rate (> 90%) using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --missing --out ${missingness}' and awk.
Perform sex concordance check using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --check-sex --out ${sexcheck}'.
Perform identity check using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --indep-pairwise 50 5 0.2 --out ${relatedness}' and genome-full analysis.
Exclude unqualified subjects.

Perform Multidimensional scaling (MDS) analysis with HapMap phase III data (build 37) using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_and_HM3_merge} --cluster --mind 0.05 --mds-plot 4 --extract ${snplist.txt} --out ${mds}'.
Filter SNPs by call rate (> 85%), HWE (p > 1 × 10^-6), and MAF (> 1%) using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --hwe 1e-6 --geno 0.15 --maf 0.01 --make-bed --out ${output}'.
Remove ambiguous strand SNPs (A/T or C/G) using awk and plink --extract.

steps.title: ADNI After-imputation Quality Control
steps.instruction: Process and filter imputed ADNI genotype data.

substeps.instruction: Convert imputed data to PLINK format using 'plink --gen ${data.imputed} --oxford-single-chr ${chr} --sample ${phased.sample} --make-bed --out ${output}'.
Filter for IMPUTE info quality score > 0.8 using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --extract ${imputed_info0.8_snp} --make-bed --out ${output}'.
Merge genotype data using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --bmerge ${genotype_data2.bed} ${genotype_data2.bim} ${genotype_data2.fam} --make-bed --out ${output}'.
Apply final filters: SNP call rate > 85%, HWE p > 1 × 10^-6, and MAF > 0.01 using 'plink --bfile ${genotype_data} --hwe 1e-6 --geno 0.15 --maf 0.01 --make-bed --out ${output}'.

steps.title: Predict Gene Expression in ADNI
steps.instruction: Predict hippocampal gene expression in ADNI samples using PrediXcan.

substeps.instruction: Create dosage files using 'python convert_plink_to_dosage.py -p plink -b ${genotype_data} -o ${chr}'.
Predict expression using 'python PrediXcan.py --predict --weights ${db_file} --dosages ${dosage_folder} --dosages_prefix ${chr} --samples ${genotype_data.fam} --output_prefix ${output}'.

steps.title: Validate AD-related Genes in ADNI
steps.instruction: Perform statistical validation of predicted gene expression in ADNI data.

substeps.instruction: Use binary logistic regression to compare hippocampal gene expression between AD vs CN and MCI-C vs MCI-S groups.
Use linear regression to explore the correlation between hippocampal gene expression and hippocampal volume.
Use multiple linear regression to identify the total effect of multiple genes on hippocampal volume.

steps.title: Perform Mediation Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct mediation analysis using the PROCESS macro for SPSS (v3.4).

substeps.instruction: Set the independent variable as hippocampal cis-genetically regulated expression for each gene.
Set the mediator variable as mean hippocampal volume (adjusted by linear regression with MR field strength).
Set the binary dependent variable as disease state (AD versus CN).
Include age, gender, and education as covariates.
